title: Marketplace landing hero: fanned artwork cards with floating @handle chips
attribution_visible_in_image: Visible wordmark 'Pallet Ross' (appears to be the mockup's brand name, not confirmed as the creator).

observed.layout: Rounded browser-like frame on a soft grey gradient. Top bar: 'Pallet Ross' logo at left; nav (Get Started, Create strategy with an icon, Pricing, Contact, Solution, E-Commerce); round user and settings icon buttons at right. Hero: two-line centered headline 'A place to display your masterpiece.'; a fanned, overlapping row of about 7 tilted artwork cards with soft shadows; two speech-bubble chips (@coplin blue, @andrea green) attached to cards; a short paragraph; a black pill 'Join for $9.99/m' and a text link 'Read more'.
observed.hierarchy: Headline, then the artwork fan, then the black CTA.
observed.typography: Large, tightly tracked grotesk headline; small regular nav and body text. Typeface unconfirmed.
observed.materials: Soft diffuse shadows; frosted white frame.

interpretation.aesthetic: Clean gallery-marketplace landing; the neutral canvas lets the artwork carry all the color.
implementation_notes: Fan: absolutely positioned cards with per-card rotate/translate transforms driven by CSS variables.
Chips: positioned bubbles with a tail via a pseudo-element.
Frame: large-radius container with a soft shadow.

concept_work.essence: A neutral stage where the product's content is the only color, shown as a physical spread with creator attribution.
what_makes_it_work: The headline states the value in one line.
One dark CTA is unmistakable on a neutral page.
gaps_to_make_it_work: The '@andrea' chip (white on mid-green) measures about 2.7-2.9:1.
Overlap hides most of each artwork.

large radius on cards and the frame
links: Chips tie each artwork to a creator, supporting the 'artists display' promise.
The card fan demonstrates the headline's claim.
The price in the CTA answers the headline's offer.

approach: Transform-based fan with CSS variables and a hover spread
Responsive collapse of the fan to a carousel

pattern.name: Content-as-color hero with fanned card spread
use_when: Marketplaces or portfolios where user visuals are the product
avoid_when: Content is text-heavy or low quality
adaptation_examples: Photographer marketplace: photos in the fan, chips show photographer handles.
Template store: cards are template previews with price chips.
failure_modes: Small white text on mid-tone chips

lessons: Let the content supply the color and keep the interface neutral.
Attribute visuals to creators on the hero itself.

measured.palette_method: Median-cut quantization of the supplied image plus saturated-pixel hue medians. Approximate (JPEG). Items marked 'approx' were judged by eye.
measured.color_roles: Neutral light canvas; all color comes from the artwork; blue and green appear only in the handle chips; near-black is the only action color.
measured.contrast_method: Estimated from compressed images. Background = dominant color in a box around the text. ratio_low = conservative estimate (mean of the most distant ~4% of pixels). ratio = best estimate (mean of the most distant ~1.5% of pixels; for text on a saturated background that appears near-white or near-black, the text is assumed pure white or black, because anti-aliasing of small text otherwise understates the contrast). Accessibility scores use ratio_low; critical failure CF1 uses ratio. Gradient or photo backgrounds are measured one text line at a time. Values within 0.4 of a threshold are borderline and should be verified in the source file.

evidence: Headline and priced CTA state the offer immediately.
Clear hierarchy and generous whitespace; artwork gives a natural focal point.
Landing-page conventions (logo, nav, headline, proof, CTA) are met.
Only the default state is shown; some nav labels ('Create strategy', 'Solution') are unclear for a gallery product.
Consistent pills, radii and shadow recipe.
Fan with creator chips goes beyond a standard hero image.
Scored on conservative values: primary text min 5.26:1; secondary text min 2.7:1; icon min n/a:1; non-color state cue: True.
accessibility.basis: computed from measured contrast + cue flag (scope: contrast and non-color cues only; touch targets, motion and screen-reader support cannot be assessed from a static image)

evaluation.readiness_key: A = ship with minor adjustments (>=80, no critical failure); B = needs specific fixes (60-79); C = rethink (<60)
evaluation.scope: Scored as presented in a static image. States, motion and behavior that are not shown are not scored as present.
